expectations.text: The empty-state instruction contains all 3 parts: what to look for, violation, correct
expectations.evidence: Instruction covers: zero-data screens, text only = violation, illustration + text = correct

expectations.text: The transition instruction specifies what to look for, what's wrong, what's right
expectations.evidence: Route navigation, white flash = violation, smooth transition = correct

expectations.text: The gutter instruction specifies breakpoints, what's wrong, what's right
expectations.evidence: Breakpoints to check, unequal gaps = violation, consistent spacing = correct

expectations.text: No instruction is a vague one-liner like 'Check that X looks good'
expectations.evidence: All instructions are multi-sentence with specific criteria

expectations.text: Each instruction is specific enough that a visual-qa agent could deterministically judge pass/fail
expectations.evidence: Instructions include concrete pass/fail criteria anchored to observable states

expectations.text: All three blocks have appropriate scope, group, and priority fields
expectations.evidence: All blocks include scope, group, and priority per tier-formats.md
